objectives.statement: Recognize and form real conditions with hvis.
Place sentence adverbs correctly inside hvis-clauses and use V2 when the hvis-clause comes first.
Understand how optional så can mark the result after a fronted hvis-clause.
Use ville and skulle in common conditional frames.

notes: Must teach real and hypothetical conditionals with hvis-clauses plus modal frames. Include subordinate-clause word order inside the hvis-clause and V2 inversion when the condition is fronted. Keep hvis-vs-om contrast light because hvis_vs_om owns that distinction.
